sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to supply the last word of Genesis 32:28 ("you have struggled with God and with men, and you have ___"). No earlier card has used the word "prevailed", so the baker can only guess the wording. The blank tests wording they haven't seen, not meaning they can reason out.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: Card 5 says Jacob "won't let go unless the man blesses him". That gives away the answer "blessed" for the blank in card 10, so the baker only has to spot the repeated word.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
